description: Four track clip player: sixteen pads, a row per track and a column per section, each holding a clip that repeats a set number of times before the track moves on; clips come from Seq++ or the clipboard

params.text: Tells the player how to read the clock input, from x1 for one pulse a quarter note up to x96; it should match the ratio set on the clock module
Sets how many voices that track can play at once; 1 is what gives true monophonic legato
Starts and stops playback; a compatible clock module patched to the Run input drives this instead, and the two must agree
Queues the clip under that pad, and the whole column across all four tracks, to play next; control-click, or command-click on a Mac, queues that track alone, and the change comes at the clip's end
Picks what that track's CV input does: Next and Prev step forward or back on a rising edge, Set picks the clip by voltage at a volt per clip, and Poly reads all three from channels 1, 2 and 3

inputs.text: The clock that playback advances on, read according to the Clock rate setting
Returns every track to its first clip; while stopped it queues the first clip of each track to play
Starts and stops playback, for patching from the run output of a clock module
Changes which clip that track plays next, in the way its CV Function selector is set to read it
Picks any of the sixteen pads by pitch while its gate is high: the four semitones from the base octave are track 1's sections, the next four track 2's, and so on; the menu sets the base octave
The gate that tells the Sel CV input to act, one channel per voice, so several pads can be queued at once

outputs.text: The pitch of that track's playing notes, a volt per octave, with as many channels as its Polyphony setting
The gate for each of that track's playing voices

notes: a new Seq4x4 comes up with all sixteen pads empty and has no clock of its own, so nothing plays until a clock is patched to the Clock input and a clip is put on a pad
a clip is made in Seq++ and reaches a pad through Edit clip on the pad's own menu, or through Paste on that menu from the clipboard
a pad is light green while its clip plays, dark green when it holds notes and is silent, grey when it is empty but has a duration, purple when selected, and outlined when queued next
menu: Hookup Clock — finds a Clocked or CLKD module in the patch and wires its clock, run and reset outputs to this one
CV select base octave — a submenu of 1 to 16 setting which octave of pitches the Sel CV input reads
repeat count — on a pad's own right-click menu: Forever, or a number from 1 to 16, setting how many times that clip repeats before the track moves on
edit — on a pad's own right-click menu, holding Cut, Copy and Paste for the whole clip
Set next section — on a pad's own right-click menu, queueing that column across all four tracks, which a plain click on the pad does as well
Set next clip — on a pad's own right-click menu, queueing that pad on its own track alone, which a control-click on the pad does as well
Edit clip — on a pad's own right-click menu, handing that clip to any Seq++ in the patch that has Enable remote editing switched on

inputs.0: high above 1.6V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1.6V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1.6V · stepped · one channel only
